system.description: Your body can redistribute impact across various points of your skeletal structure. When you take damage, you can spend your Reaction, to reduce the triggering damage by 2d8. You then immediately move up to 10 feet into a direction of your choice without provoking opportunity attacks as your body repurposes the kinetic energy. Beginning at 7th level, increase the damage reduction by 1d8, and an additional 1d8 at 15th level.
